task.description: Design comprehensive test coverage for ADP-03 and align/augment existing tests. Produce or update test specs to verify deterministic tenant context resolution for tokens with and without tenant_id, tenant-scoped request behavior, cross-tenant isolation rejection paths, and default-tenant compatibility for legacy tokens. Ensure explicit traceability to ADP-03 acceptance and dependencies API-08/OIDC-13/ADP-01/ADP-02.
acceptance_criteria: Test spec(s) map ADP-03 acceptance criteria to concrete unit/integration cases
Both happy-path tenant scoping and cross-tenant rejection paths are covered
Default-tenant compatibility for tokens without tenant_id is explicitly validated
Planned or updated tests are actionable for TEST-RUNNER without ambiguity

result.summary: Designed comprehensive ADP-03 test coverage and augmented integration tests for deterministic tenant context resolution, tenant-scoped request behavior, cross-tenant read/write rejection paths, invalid tenant claim rejection, and default-tenant compatibility for legacy tokens, with explicit traceability to API-08, OIDC-13, ADP-01, and ADP-02.
